issues.description: Test replaces additions=[] with a zero-amount/zero-puzzle-hash Addition, masking the legacy fallback path
issues.detail: Tests changed additions=[] to additions=[Addition(amount=uint64(0), puzzle_hash=bytes32.zeros)] to dodge CreateSignedTransaction's __post_init__ guard. This no longer exercises the amount/inner_address fallback branch and risks creating a zero-value coin to a null puzzle hash. Add a dedicated test for the request.additions is None fallback or restore prior semantics.

issues.description: send_transaction address validation narrows from network-prefix check to ensure_valid_address with AddressType.XCH only
issues.detail: The old path only compared the configured network prefix; the new path enforces allowed_types={AddressType.XCH}. This may reject testnet (TXCH) prefixes or other valid prefixes (NFT/DID) previously accepted, breaking existing clients. Confirm the tightening is intentional and parity with the configured network is preserved.

issues.description: Explicit MAX_COIN_AMOUNT validation removed from cat_spend additions path
issues.detail: Old cat_spend explicitly raised ValueError when addition.amount > MAX_COIN_AMOUNT. The refactor delegates to create_signed_transaction without a visible equivalent at this layer. If downstream enforcement differs in message, path, or omits the check, callers relying on the prior error semantics regress. Verify equivalent enforcement downstream.

issues.description: Memo encoding semantics changed: list[str] forwarded into Addition.memos instead of pre-encoded list[bytes]
issues.detail: Original send_transaction and cat_spend encoded memos via mem.encode('utf-8') before passing to generate_signed_transaction. The new code stuffs request.memos (list[str]) into Addition.memos directly. If create_signed_transaction's downstream pipeline does not perform identical utf-8 encoding and alignment, memo wire format can regress silently. Confirm parity.

The shared helper uses `None in {extra_delta, tail_reveal, tail_solution}`, which depends on hashability and dedupes silently. Prefer `any(x is None for x in (...))` or explicit None checks for clarity and to eliminate the three `# type: ignore[arg-type]` annotations that mypy still requires.

issues.description: CreateSignedTransaction accepts CAT-only fields without wallet-type guard
issues.detail: extra_delta/tail_reveal/tail_solution/puzzle_decorator were added to CreateSignedTransaction with no validation that the target wallet_id refers to a CATWallet. Callers invoking create_signed_transaction on a standard Wallet with these set will fail deep in generate_signed_transaction. Validate at the request boundary to surface errors earlier.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor sensibly consolidates send_transaction and cat_spend onto create_signed_transaction, but flags consistent behavioral risks that need verification before merge. Address validation tightens from a network-prefix check to AddressType.XCH only, which may reject testnet or non-XCH prefixes previously accepted. The explicit MAX_COIN_AMOUNT check is removed and memo encoding shifts from pre-encoded bytes to raw list[str] forwarded via Addition, both relying on downstream parity. Most critically, the test change from additions=[] to a zero-amount/zero-puzzle-hash Addition masks the legacy fallback path rather than exercising it. The extracted cat_discrepancy_validation helper is clean but uses a fragile set-membership pattern.
